strad.definition: n a violin made by Antonio Stradivari or a member of his family

strada.translation:
n. 速达路（松下汽车导航系统）；道路（意大利语）
n. (Strada)人名；(意)斯特拉达

stradap.translation: (=storm radar data processor)风暴预警雷达数据处理机

straddle.definition:
n. a noncommittal or equivocal position
n. a gymnastic exercise performed with a leg on either side of the parallel bars
n. the act of sitting or standing astride
n. the option to buy or sell a given stock (or stock index or commodity future) at a given price before a given date; consists of an equal number of put and call options
straddle.translation:
n. 跨坐, 观望
v. 跨坐, 两腿叉开坐, 观望

straddled.translation: v. 叉开腿( straddle的过去式和过去分词 ); 跨坐; 横跨…的两边; 跨越…的两边

straddles.definition:
n a noncommittal or equivocal position
n a gymnastic exercise performed with a leg on either side of the parallel bars
n the act of sitting or standing astride
n the option to buy or sell a given stock (or stock index or commodity future) at a given price before a given date; consists of an equal number of put and call options
v sit or stand astride of
v range or extend over; occupy a certain area
v be noncommittal
straddles.translation: v. 叉开腿( straddle的第三人称单数 ); 跨坐; 横跨…的两边; 跨越…的两边

straddling.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Straddle
a. Applied to spokes when they are arranged alternately in
   two circles in the hub. See Straddle, v. i., and Straddle, v. t., 3.
straddling.translation: v. 叉开腿( straddle的现在分词 ); 跨坐; 横跨…的两边; 跨越…的两边

stradivari.definition: n Italian violin maker who developed the modern violin and created violins of unequaled tonal quality (1644?-1737)
stradivari.translation: n. 弦乐器(尤指斯特拉迪瓦里及其子制作的小提琴)
